source_snapshot.test_name_items: BMC network configuration→Lan channel Configuration Address
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot into setup menu and configure the BMC IP to DHCP option. Then save and exit.
2. Boot into BIOS setup menu again for checking the IP address.
3. Login to BMC web UI with the DHCP IP
4. Boot into setup menu and configure a BMC static IP. Then save and exit.
5. Boot into BIOS setup menu again for checking the IP address.
6. Login to BMC web UI with the static IP

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BMC should get a DHCP IP and could be pinged and log into BMC web UI successfully
2. BMC should be set to static IP and could be pinged and log into BMC web UI successfully

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BMC network configuration→Lan channel Configuration Address: read the BMC LAN channel configuration (address source, IP, MAC) ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP|MAC|Subnet|Source".
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the LAN channel print (address source/IP/netmask/MAC) so the user confirms the BIOS-listed BMC network config matches ipmitool.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; only reads the current channel and omits both BIOS mutations, DHCP lease discovery, ping and two BMC WebUI logins.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; restores the DHCP/static workflow and management recovery controls, although its purpose incorrectly says move back after static when the source ends at static.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Through the BIOS setup path, configure BMC addressing to DHCP and then to an approved static address, verifying the displayed address, ping reachability and successful BMC WebUI login in each state.
original_method: Record baseline/MAC, set DHCP in BIOS and save/exit, rediscover the lease, verify the BIOS-displayed DHCP address, ping and WebUI login, then repeat the evidence sequence for an approved static IP and leave or restore the final state per project plan.
manual_activity: A human must perform/capture both BIOS network changes and visually confirm the BIOS address plus successful BMC WebUI login in both states. Automated LAN queries and ping are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: BMC MAC and current LAN baseline
Approved DHCP network and lease lookup method
Approved static IP/netmask/gateway and duplicate-IP result
Alternate recovery path and final desired configuration
safety_requirements: Obtain one-authorized-user approval for the unchanged two-state network plan.
Validate static address ownership and DHCP scope before any change.
Maintain console or alternate local/OOB recovery independent of the address being changed.
Verify the BMC MAC/identity after each transition before submitting credentials.
Stop on duplicate IP, wrong identity, lease ambiguity or loss of recovery access.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full read-only lan print output, MAC, reachability and lease evidence after approval.
Correlate BIOS captures, ping and authenticated-login evidence for DHCP and static states.
Monitor health and prepare results without performing the human WebUI acceptance or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve network values, credentials handling, recovery and final state.
Perform/capture BIOS DHCP/static changes and address displays.
Log in to the BMC WebUI at each confirmed address and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful read-only corroboration, but grep-filtered current-state output cannot execute or prove the two transitions, lease identity, ping or WebUI login.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve a complete ipmitool lan print 1 capture for each state and add controlled ping/lease correlation; do not use lan set as a substitute for the BIOS path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DHCP then static order, BIOS rechecks, both WebUI logins, no-script state and 30/50-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind DHCP lease and static endpoint evidence to the same BMC MAC, retain complete LAN output, capture BIOS display, record ping results, and collect a redacted authenticated WebUI session artifact for each state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC LAN channel and BIOS setup implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, ipmitool, browser and DHCP service versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner network plan and platform BIOS/BMC LAN configuration guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity binding, duplicate prevention and alternate recovery without replacing BIOS or WebUI steps.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Address changes can terminate the active management session; cached ARP/DNS or reused leases can point to another endpoint.

project_override_considerations: A project may supply different approved addresses or final-state restoration and record completion for that plan. It may not skip either source state or replace the BIOS/WebUI observations with a LAN query alone.
expected_evidence: BMC identity/MAC, baseline LAN state, approvals and alternate recovery
DHCP BIOS setting/address, lease-to-MAC mapping, full LAN output, ping and WebUI-login evidence
Static BIOS setting/address, duplicate check, full LAN output, ping and WebUI-login evidence
Transition timestamps and absence of wrong-endpoint access
Final approved LAN state, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require DHCP followed by static configuration with address, ping and WebUI validation. Missing network values are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is explicit. Missing network parameters, credentials, console or recovery make execution not ready but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains lan print only as supporting evidence and restores all omitted state changes and acceptance checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its network safety plan while correcting the source order/final-state statement and applying MANUAL ONLY to BIOS plus WebUI core actions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automated network evidence, manual acceptance and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a single filtered LAN read from being claimed as proof of two management-address transitions and guards credentials against wrong-endpoint login.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive workflow requires repeated BIOS configuration/observation and successful human BMC WebUI login, both explicitly manual core activities under V3.1. Ping and IPMI collection do not change the MANUAL ONLY classification.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat either address change, ping sweep or login automatically after failure; preserve state/evidence and use the approved recovery path under engineer direction.
